the sensory quality of tomato is influenced both by genetic factors and environmental ones.

the genetic background of ecotypes is more closely related to sensory attributes linked to taste perception and fruit texture, whereas environmental factors are more closely linked with sensory attributes related to fruit colour and aroma perception.
, in order to improve sensory traits in tomato breeding, it is necessary to consider not only genetic but also environmental factors.

the sensory quality of tomato is not only determined by the genotype of the plant but also by the environmental conditions in which it is grown.
sensory traits are not only influenced by the genetic background but also by the environment.

the genetic background of ecotypes is more important for the perception of tomato flavour and texture than the environmental conditions.
